title: Parthen Rasithen
desc: Shankar, a graduate, awaits recruitment and lives as a tenant with Bhanu who seeks his company to stay away from her stepbrother. Meanwhile, Shankar begins to fall in love with Sarika.

title: 5 Star
desc: Five college friends promise to stay together even after completing their education. However, one of them hides from the others that he has been forced to marry a village girl.

title: Vaanatha Pola
desc: Vellaichaamy sacrifices love for his three brothers, resisting marriage when he discovers his beloved intends to separate them.

title: Naan Rajavaaga Pogiren
desc: Jeeva, who leads a good life in Himachal Pradesh, learns that he has a lookalike, Raja, who is a boxer in Chennai. Intrigued by the notion, Jeeva sets out on an adventurous journey to find Raja.

title: Vandi
desc: Three roommates, who are trying to make their ends meet, land in trouble due to a stolen bike that has been extensively used by robbers for executing their plans

title: Pandiya Naadu
desc: Shiva's perfect life turns upside down after his brother is killed by a dreaded gangster. Bent on revenge, Shiva turns into a ruthless killer and vows to eliminate his brother's killers.

title: Nageswary
desc: A night before her wedding, Nagaveni and her brother are assaulted and killed by her fiance, Eashwar, and his friends. However, she rises from the dead and sets out to take revenge on them.

title: Acharam
desc: Suriya, a sub-inspector, hates modern women and kills them secretly at night. When he meets Ramya, the wife of an architect, he becomes obsessed with her.

title: Vanmam
desc: Friends Radha and Chelladurai lead a carefree life. When Radha accidentally kills Chelladurai's brother-in-law, it turns them bitter foes, and a cunning man uses their enmity to his benefits

title: Anbe Un Vasam
desc: A boy falls in love with a girl who also reciprocates his feelings. Scared by another love affair going sour, he proposes to her. But, things go wrong when her point of view differs from his.

title: 12 B
desc: While working at a friend's garage, Shakti falls in love with Jotika. However, her parents want her to marry Pratap, a rich businessman. What will be the outcome of this love triangle

title: Style
desc: Four college friends try to help two lovers get married against the wishes of their parents. The attempts of the youngsters lead to hilarious consequences.

title: Minnale
desc: A man falls in love with a woman and cons his way into her heart through lies. When she finds out and confronts him, he has no sign of remorse as he feels that everything is fair in love and war.

title: Coimbatore Mappllai
desc: Balu comes to the city for better opportunities and stays with his friend. He falls in love with Sumithra, his landlord, but her evil cousin, Mahesh, creates a rift between them.

title: Iniyavaley
desc: Prabhakar is firm on marrying only after he clears his exams and becomes a collector. When his parents fix his marriage, his protests lead to complications and he ends up marrying the bride's sister.

title: Amma Appa Cheliam
desc: Chellam, a boy from a poor family, is in love with a rich girl but ignores her by focusing on his career while making his parents proud by scoring the highest in the district.

title: Cheran Chozhan Pandian
desc: After being released from jail Cheran, Chozhan, and Pandian are determined to reform, they encounter the corrupt politician Swamy. They befriend Gayathri, Swamy's sister, leading to complications.
